title: Zarankiewicz numbers near the triple system threshold
summary: For positive integers $m$ and $n$, the Zarankiewicz number $Z_{2,2}(m,n)$ can be defined as the maximum total degree of a linear hypergraph with $m$ vertices and $n$ edges. Guy determined $Z_{2,2}(m,n)$ for all $n \geq \binom{m}{2}/3+O(m)$. Here, we extend this by determining $Z_{2,2}(m,n)$ for all $n \geq \binom{m}{2}/3$ and, when $m$ is large, for all $n \geq \binom{m}{2}/6+O(m)$.
